verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS product that mentions having an API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and every probed spec path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. A general mention of an 'API' is adjacent and does not show a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
